headlines.title: Fed Revamps Bank Stress Tests: What Does it Mean for U.S. Banks?
headlines.summary: The Federal Reserve has finalized revisions to its annual bank stress-testing framework aimed at increasing transparency and reducing volatility in capital requirements. Starting in 2028, stress capital buffers (SCBs) will be calculated using two-year averages of supervisory stress tests, potentially reducing year-over-year volatility by roughly 50%. While this should provide major banks with greater visibility for capital planning, the changes are unlikely to result in broad-based capital relief, with benefits varying by institution based on trading exposure and fee-income composition.

BAC.title: Fed Revamps Bank Stress Tests: What Does it Mean for U.S. Banks?
BAC.summary: The Federal Reserve has finalized revisions to its annual bank stress-testing framework aimed at increasing transparency and reducing volatility in capital requirements. Starting in 2028, stress capital buffers (SCBs) will be calculated using two-year averages of supervisory stress tests, potentially reducing year-over-year volatility by roughly 50%. While this should provide major banks with greater visibility for capital planning, the changes are unlikely to result in broad-based capital relief, with benefits varying by institution based on trading exposure and fee-income composition.

Starting in 2028, stress capital buffers (SCBs) will be calculated using two-year averages of supervisory stress tests, potentially reducing year-over-year volatility by roughly 50%. While this should provide major banks with greater visibility for capital planning, the changes are unlikely to result in broad-based capital relief, with benefits varying by institution based on trading exposure and fee-income composition.

BACpK.title: JPMorgan Trades Below 50-Day SMA: Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
BACpK.summary: JPMorgan (JPM) is trading below its 50-day simple moving average, signaling near-term technical weakness, though fundamental support remains solid. Strong capital position enables a $50 billion buyback program and 10% dividend increase to $1.65 per share. AMJB.title: Fed Revamps Bank Stress Tests: What Does it Mean for U.S. Banks?
AMJB.summary: The Federal Reserve has finalized revisions to its annual bank stress-testing framework aimed at increasing transparency and reducing volatility in capital requirements. Starting in 2028, stress capital buffers (SCBs) will be calculated using two-year averages of supervisory stress tests, potentially reducing year-over-year volatility by roughly 50%. While this should provide major banks with greater visibility for capital planning, the changes are unlikely to result in broad-based capital relief, with benefits varying by institution based on trading exposure and fee-income composition.

CpN.title: Citigroup Deepens Stablecoin Push With Expanded Coinbase Tie-Up
CpN.summary: Citigroup has expanded its partnership with Coinbase to enable institutional clients to accept stablecoin-based payments and settle in fiat currency. The collaboration integrates Coinbase's digital-asset infrastructure with Citigroup's virtual accounts, payment, and settlement capabilities through services like Spring by Citi. This move positions Citigroup to capture growth in the stablecoin ecosystem while leveraging its existing relationships with major e-commerce and fintech companies.

CpR.title: Fed Revamps Bank Stress Tests: What Does it Mean for U.S. Banks?
CpR.summary: The Federal Reserve has finalized revisions to its annual bank stress-testing framework aimed at increasing transparency and reducing volatility in capital requirements. Starting in 2028, stress capital buffers (SCBs) will be calculated using two-year averages of supervisory stress tests, potentially reducing year-over-year volatility by roughly 50%. While this should provide major banks with greater visibility for capital planning, the changes are unlikely to result in broad-based capital relief, with benefits varying by institution based on trading exposure and fee-income composition.

MPC.title: Is Pacer US Cash Cows 100 ETF (COWZ) a Strong ETF Right Now?
MPC.summary: COWZ is a smart beta ETF launched in 2016 that tracks companies with high free cash flow yields, offering 0.49% expense ratio and 2.03% dividend yield. MPC.title: Can HF Sinclair's Go-West Initiative Drive Long-Term Midstream Growth?
MPC.summary: HF Sinclair's Go-West initiative aims to expand midstream operations by moving Rockies supply into Western markets, with Phase 1 targeting 35,000 BPD capacity into Nevada by 2029 and potential scaling to 140,000-150,000 BPD. The project leverages existing infrastructure to capture value from supply-demand imbalances in Western fuel markets. Similar strategies are being pursued by Marathon Petroleum and Phillips 66 to strengthen their midstream operations.

QURE.title: UNIQURE INVESTIGATION: QURE Securities Investors Encouraged to Contact Kirby McInerney LLP About Their Rights

QURE.title: uniQure Plunges on Additional Data From Huntington's Disease Study

At 36 months, the therapy showed 80% slowing in cUHDRS and 67% in TFC versus external controls. However, 48-month data showed weaker results with cUHDRS at 44% slowing (not statistically significant) and TFC at 61% slowing. The stock plunged 37% following the announcement. The company has submitted a BLA to the FDA based on 36-month data, with regulatory review and durability validation as key upcoming catalysts.
